    - paragraph: Serverless, fully managed, distributed NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond performance at any scale

    - heading "What is DynamoDB" [level=2]
    - paragraph: DynamoDB offers zero infrastructure management, instant scaling, pay-per-request billing, and no cold starts, upgrades, or maintenance windows. These capabilities, along with native vector search, make DynamoDB ideal for agentic applications that need semantic retrieval. For globally distributed applications, DynamoDB global tables is a multi-Region, multi-active database with up to 99.999% availability. It supports multi-Region strong consistency enabling your applications to always stay available and read the same data from any Region, so you can build zero recovery point objective applications. A broad set of DynamoDB security controls and compliance standards satisfy the requirements for governments, global banks, and other high-sensitivity organizations.
